Author: P529
Name: FF14Chat
Punchline: Tabbed chat replacement with tell tabs and command autocompletion.
Description: A chat replacement window: configurable tabs, a separate tab per tell conversation, command autocompletion, and persistent chat history. Toggle with /ff14chat. Also adds /mountid, which prints the mount a nearby character is riding, and a "Try On Original" entry to the game's item context menus that previews a glamoured item's own model.
